# GitHub Repository Configuration

This directory contains GitHub-specific configuration: Actions workflows, the pull request template, and thin Copilot adapters. The canonical project rules and reusable agent workflows live in [`.codex/`](../.codex/README.md).

Keep project architecture, naming, API, state, accounting, UI, and verification rules in `.codex/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`. Copilot instructions, commands, and agent profiles should point to that context and its workflows rather than define competing rules.
